## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

- **2026-09-10 — OpenAI: Data agent in ChatGPT Work**  
  Source: [OpenAI — Now everyone can put data to work](https://openai.com/index/put-data-to-work)  
  OpenAI introduced a Data agent for ChatGPT Work that connects company data, supports natural-language analysis, and can generate interactive dashboards.  
  **Why it matters:** Pushes ChatGPT deeper into enterprise analytics workflows, reducing the need for specialist BI tooling for first-pass analysis.

- **2026-09-10 — OpenAI: Agents API**  
  Source: [OpenAI — Introducing the Agents API](https://openai.com/index/introducing-the-agents-api)  
  OpenAI announced a managed Agents API for cloud-hosted agents with orchestration, long-running sessions, tool use, and Codex-harness-based execution.  
  **Why it matters:** Moves agent deployment from local/prototype workflows toward managed infrastructure, making persistent production agents easier to operate.

- **2026-09-10 — OpenAI: GPT‑Live‑1 voice API**  
  Source: [OpenAI — Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-live-1-in-the-api)  
  GPT‑Live‑1 brings full-duplex voice interaction to the API, including custom voices, stronger instruction following, and telephony support.  
  **Why it matters:** Strengthens the voice-agent stack for call centers, assistants, and real-time spoken interfaces.

- **2026-09-10 — OpenAI: ChatGPT for Financial Services**  
  Source: [OpenAI — Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services](https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-financial-services)  
  OpenAI introduced a financial-services product combining financial data access with GPT‑6 Astra for research, modeling, and client-ready outputs.

- **2026-09-10 — OpenAI: ChatGPT release notes expand data/file integrations**
